instruction: This is a laundry room. We're facing the wall of it. Turn right. We should see the machines on the left. On the right, there is two paintings. Get out of here and then turn left. Let's check out the horse painting in front of us. Turn right and enter the nice big bathroom, and turn left, getting closer to the nightstand on the left of the bed. Enter the bathroom attached to the bedroom. Move along the shower area until we see the toilet. Enter the walk-in closet attached to the bathroom. Stop right in front of the shoe shelf.
